name: How do I compare structural remodeling contractors?

mainEntity.name: What should I compare when choosing a structural remodeling contractor in Los Angeles or Glendale?
mainEntity.text: What should I compare when choosing a structural remodeling contractor in Los Angeles or Glendale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a structural remodeling contractor requires more than comparing prices. Look for direct experience with load-bearing wall removals, beam installations, foundation-related work, and permit coordination in your city. Ask whether the contractor manages engineering and plan check, how they handle temporary shoring, and whether their proposal includes demolition, structural framing, utilities, patching, and final finishes. A vague bid can hide expensive extras that appear later as change orders. It also helps to see examples of similar projects, not just general remodeling work. Because structural remodeling affects safety and inspections, communication matters as much as craftsmanship. The best contractor will explain the sequence clearly, identify likely hidden-condition risks, and provide a realistic timeline. In a market like Los Angeles, where homes vary widely in age and framing style, local experience with the permit process and older construction is especially valuable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare structural experience, permit and engineering coordination, past projects with load-bearing wall removal, insurance, scheduling, and the clarity of the proposal. The lowest bid is not always the best choice if it excludes engineering, shoring, inspections, or finish repair.
